title: add-benchmark-lab-performance-suites-reporting-pipeline-v137
author: Aisha Khan
release_notes: Adds v137 performance suites and reporting pipeline; improves metric labeling for kernel selection and adds cold-start profiling job. No user-facing API changes.
description: Motivation: our benchmark lab continues to expand coverage for edge case workloads and kernel selection profiling. This PR adds the v137 performance suites (mixed and multimodal variants), wires them into the reporting pipeline, improves telemetry labels for kernel selection experiments, and adds a cold-start profiling job to help track warmup costs. Changes include new suite definitions, runner adapters for the mixed workloads, a reporting job harness that attaches kernel-selection metadata, and a small prometheus exporter patch for new labels. Checklist: 1) Add performance suites YAML for v137; 2) Add representative workload runner adapters for mixed/multimodal tests; 3) Extend reporting pipeline to ingest new suite outputs and persist kernel selection metadata; 4) Add cold-start profiling CI job; 5) Update docs/README to reference v137. Related: ENG-7421, ENG-7810. Impact: internal tooling for benchmarking and telemetry only. Rollout: merged to main; jobs scheduled in benchmark-lab GCP project. See files_changed for details.
commits: Add v137 performance suite definitions and runners
Wire reporting pipeline to accept kernel-selection metadata
Add cold-start profiling job and prometheus labels
review_comments: Marta Liu: Can you add a short description of the new workload characteristics (seq len distribution, token mix) in the README?
Aisha Khan: Added high-level descriptions to docs/benchmark-lab/README.md and included sample histograms.
Owen Carter: The prometheus label change looks fine but please ensure backward compatibility for existing dashboards — consider keeping old label keys for 2 releases.
Aisha Khan: Exporter now preserves old label keys (kernel_hint -> kernel_hint_v1) and appends kernel_hint for new pipelines.
Diego Ramos: CI job runs are flaky on smaller GPUs, can we gate the cold-start profiling to medium+ runners?
Aisha Khan: Cold-start profiling job now targets medium/large runner pool; added guard in ci config.
Marta Liu: Approving pending green CI and one minor doc tweak.
notes: This PR consolidates several benchmark-lab improvements. The reporting pipeline change adds a small schema field (kernel_selection_metadata) which is backwards compatible with existing storage. Teams owning downstream dashboards should re-run their ingestion job to pick up the kernel_hint label. The cold-start profiling job is scheduled on a weekly cadence in prod benchmark project.
short_summary: Adds v137 performance suites, mixed/multimodal runners, kernel-selection metadata ingestion, and cold-start profiling job to benchmark lab.
post_merge_actions: Trigger benchmark-lab/reports pipeline to process v137 results
Notify telemetry team to update dashboards for new kernel_hint label
